visual_summary: A public ceremony is underway before a large crowd in a grand arena or civic hall. A heavily armored noble figure stands on a dais, being acclaimed by the audience and seemingly welcomed into the nobility. The scene is interrupted when a young woman pushes forward shouting to stop the award. She accuses the candidate of being unworthy because one decisive vote is missing: her father’s, whom she says was murdered by the armored figure. In the final panels, a chest is opened and a skull or bone fragment is presented as evidence while the woman points at the accused.
